bio: Philippo Santangelo and his right-arm man John Oremans take their time to ensure that your culinary experience will be truly memorable. They invite you to step inside their tastefully appointed townhouse and lovely adjoining garden. Their modern version of Italian cuisine from the authentic flavours of minestrone soup, which are treated to a creative new twist, to the cannelloni of sole in a noisette butter sauce, has already acquired numerous fans....
